en: A museum-style postcard with two color photographs mounted on a cream background. The left photo shows the interior of a stone castle room with rough masonry walls, a small arched doorway, modern black floor lamps, and a large stone statue of a standing figure in one corner. The right photo is a close-up of a medieval-style stone statue of an armored knight or nobleman with a cape and shield, standing against the same kind of stone wall. At the top of the card there is printed and handwritten Finnish text indicating the castle and institution.
